title: How a Fashion House Transfers Tacit Knowledge
author: RN Collins
rightsRule: Evidence leads; atmosphere never substitutes for provenance.

carouselA.title: How a Fashion House Transfers Tacit Knowledge: the institutional sequence

frames.caption: A house transfers tacit knowledge by pairing records with situated practice: demonstration, attempt, correction, comparison, narration, and trusted authority. The goal is not to extract every secret, but to preserve what collaborators may ethically carry.
frames.alt: Title plate for How a Fashion House Transfers Tacit Knowledge.
frames.treatment: typography, rule, folio and domain color only

frames.caption: The ensemble carries material decisions across components; the surviving object cannot narrate every demonstration, correction, and embodied judgment that produced them.
frames.credit: Brooklyn Museum Costume Collection at The Metropolitan Museum of Art; Gift of Edith Gardiner, 1926
frames.alt: House of Worth ensemble from 1893 in dark silk with jet and metal ornament, shown frontally.
frames.treatment: local display and download with attached credit

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 01 · SHOW — What must be demonstrated?. Identify judgments that resist prose: hand position, tension, sequence, sound, resistance, drape, finishing threshold, and the moment an expert stops. Record only with informed permission.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping what must be demonstrated? within How a Fashion House Transfers Tacit Knowledge.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 02 · TRY — Where does the learner practice?. Design a bounded attempt using sacrificial material, time for repetition, and permission to fail. Apprenticeship is labor and education; compensation, safety, access, and jurisdiction must be addressed.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping where does the learner practice? within How a Fashion House Transfers Tacit Knowledge.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 03 · CORRECT — How is judgment calibrated?. Preserve paired examples, expert commentary, acceptable variation, non-negotiable failure, and the reason for correction. Record disagreement instead of forcing false consensus.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping how is judgment calibrated? within How a Fashion House Transfers Tacit Knowledge.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 04 · RETURN — Who retains authority over the knowledge?. Define consent, attribution, confidentiality, access, benefit, revocation, cultural authority, archive custody, and successor permissions. Not all knowledge should become a company asset or public lesson.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

frames.caption: Documentation can democratize access, but it can also extract knowledge from workers and communities, freeze evolving practice, expose trade secrets, or privilege what a camera can capture. Ethical transfer includes the right not to record and the power to govern future use.
frames.alt: Counterpoint card for How a Fashion House Transfers Tacit Knowledge.
frames.treatment: typographic quotation field; no decorative imagery
